facts.text: Lands within 100 m of its target
Rover averages 36 m an hour, because it waits about nine tenths of the time
Rover needs Earth in view to drive: it is steered from the ground
Lands 21 November 2026, 00:00 UTC, for 14 days, in sunlight with Earth in view
